title: What If Every Lie You Told Instantly Came True?

shots.vo: One lie almost erased Leo from existence. And it all started with homework.

shots.label: MONDAY, 7:12 AM
shots.vo: Leo was the worst liar in his entire school.
Leo! Did you finish your homework?
Uh... yeah. It's already done.
And that's when the air started buzzing.
His homework was done. Every page. In his own handwriting.
No way. I didn't do that. I literally didn't do that.
Good. Then come eat breakfast. And stop talking to yourself.
Okay. Test. I am six foot four.
Nothing. Because nobody heard it. A lie only works if someone believes it.
So if someone believes me... it becomes real?

shots.label: SCHOOL
shots.vo: At school, Marcus was waiting for him. Like every single day.
Lunch money. Now.
Sorry man. I'm actually a black belt in karate.
Marcus laughed. Then Leo's body moved on its own.
Bro... where did you learn that?!
The whole hallway saw it. Including Sienna.
Since when can you do that?
Oh, that? That's nothing. I'm also kind of famous.
By lunch, the whole school was talking about the new kid with the karate skills.
And that was his first really big mistake.
Leo's lies were coming true. His next lie? That he's famous. Huge mistake.

shots.label: THAT NIGHT
shots.vo: Leo told Sienna he was famous. By that night, he was.
Two point four million followers. Out of nowhere.
Bro. I have a blue checkmark. I have a blue checkmark!
His phone would not stop buzzing.
Then the messages started coming in.

messages.text: bro why are u on the news
since when do u have a song??

shots.label: NEXT MORNING
shots.vo: His song was number one. A song he never wrote.
Leo. Since when do you sing?
I've... always sung, Mom. You just never listened.
And Mom's eyes went blank for just a second.
Of course, sweetie. I've been to all your concerts.
Mom... what's my favorite song?
Yours, honey. You sing it every morning in the shower.
That was the moment Leo understood. He wasn't just changing the future.
He was rewriting people's memories.

shots.label: SCHOOL
shots.vo: At school, everyone wanted a picture. Everyone except Dev.
We've been best friends for nine years. You never sang. Not once.
Dev remembered. Dev remembered everything.
What did you do to everyone, Leo? And why am I the only one who sees it?
Which meant one person in the world knew the truth.
Only one person knew the truth. So Leo did something unforgivable.

shots.label: LUNCH
shots.vo: Dev wouldn't stop asking questions. So Leo panicked.
Something's wrong with you, man. Just tell me the truth.
There's nothing to tell. You're not even my best friend.
He said it out loud. In front of everyone.
Sorry... do I know you?
Dev, it's me. Leo. We built a treehouse together in second grade!
I've never had a treehouse. Are you okay, man?
Nine years. Gone. Dev picked up his tray and walked away.
Wait. Dev. Dev! I didn't mean it!
But you can't take back a lie. Leo tried. It doesn't work.
And across the room, Mr. Hill was watching him. Very closely.

shots.label: AFTER SCHOOL
shots.vo: Then Sienna sat down next to him.
Hey. You look like you need someone. Want to talk?
Leo almost told her everything. Almost.
I'm fine. Actually, I've had a crush on you for years. And you feel the same.
Her pupils turned into little hearts.
I love you, Leo. I've always loved you.
But her eyes looked empty. Like someone else was talking for her.
It was everything he wanted. So why did it feel so wrong?
Forty seven lies. Rich. Famous. Loved. But someone knew his secret.

shots.label: ONE WEEK LATER
shots.vo: One week later, Leo had told forty seven lies.
He was rich. Famous. Straight A's. And Sienna couldn't stop texting him.

messages.text: i love u i love u i love u

shots.vo: Leo. Stay after class. We need to talk.

shots.label: AFTER CLASS
shots.vo: Forty seven. That's how many you've told, isn't it?
How... how do you know that?
Because I had the same gift. Thirty years ago.
Then why are you a teacher? You could have had anything.
I lied my way into everything. Money. Love. A perfect life.
And at one hundred lies, it all collapsed. Every single one came back to collect.
So what happens when they reverse?
Everyone you lied to forgets you exist. Everyone.
I was married once. Today she doesn't even remember my name.
Leo thought about his mom. About Sienna. About Dev.
You have fifty three lies left, Leo. Spend them wisely.

shots.label: WALKING HOME
shots.vo: And on the way home, he made a decision.
But then a car came out of nowhere.
Headlights. A horn. No time to think.
I'm completely fine! Nothing hit me!
Lie number forty eight saved his life. He had fifty two left.
Fifty two lies left. One last plan. If it fails, Leo disappears forever.

shots.label: MIDNIGHT
shots.vo: Leo couldn't sleep. He had one idea left.
If one lie made this happen, one lie can end it.
But a lie needs someone to believe it. He needed Dev.

shots.label: DEV'S HOUSE
shots.vo: So he ran. All the way to Dev's house.
Fifty two lies left. And he only needed one.
Dude. It's midnight. Who even are you?
Please. Just listen. You're the only person who ever knew the real me.
You don't remember me. But I need you to believe one thing.
I never had any powers. None of this ever happened.
The lie that cancels every other lie.
The followers. Gone. The song. Gone. Sienna's hearts. Gone.
Mr. Hill's secret. Sienna's spell. Dev's lost memories. All of it, rewinding.

shots.label: MONDAY, 7:12 AM
shots.vo: Leo woke up in his bed. Monday morning. Again.
Leo! Did you finish your homework?
No, Mom. I didn't. I'm sorry.
It was the best thing he'd ever said. Then his phone buzzed.

messages.text: also... weird dream last night. you had powers lol

shots.vo: Dev remembered. Just a little. Just enough.

shots.label: SCHOOL
shots.vo: Yo, Leo! Treehouse this weekend? We never finished the roof.
And Leo never told another lie again. Well. Almost never.
